subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Which formula correctly gives average speed?
questions.explain: Average speed is the total distance travelled divided by the total time taken.

questions.q: Which formula correctly gives density?
questions.explain: Density is defined as mass per unit volume, so it equals mass divided by volume.

questions.q: Which formula correctly gives pressure?
questions.explain: Pressure is the force applied per unit area, so it equals force divided by area.

questions.q: Which of these is a valid unit for density?
questions.explain: Density combines mass and volume units, such as grams per cubic centimetre (g/cm³).

questions.q: In the ratio 2 : 3, how many equal parts is the whole divided into?
questions.explain: The parts of a ratio are added together, so 2 + 3 gives 5 equal parts in total.

questions.q: If y is directly proportional to x, which equation represents this?
questions.explain: Direct proportion means y equals a constant k multiplied by x.

questions.q: Which single multiplier increases an amount by 20%?
questions.explain: A 20% increase means keeping 100% and adding 20%, giving a multiplier of 1.2.

questions.q: What is the SI unit of pressure?
questions.explain: Pressure is measured in pascals (Pa), equal to one newton per square metre.

questions.q: Simplify the ratio 12 : 18 to its simplest form.
questions.explain: Dividing both parts by their highest common factor of 6 gives 2 : 3.

questions.q: Write the ratio 4 : 20 in the form 1 : n.
questions.explain: Dividing both parts by 4 gives 1 : 5.

questions.q: y is inversely proportional to x. If x is doubled, what happens to y?
questions.explain: In inverse proportion y = k/x, so doubling x halves the value of y.

questions.q: Which single multiplier decreases an amount by 15%?
questions.explain: A 15% decrease leaves 85% of the original, giving a multiplier of 0.85.

questions.q: Rearranging speed = distance ÷ time, how do you find the distance travelled?
questions.explain: Multiplying speed by time gives the distance covered.

questions.q: What does the graph of two quantities in direct proportion look like?
options: A straight line through the origin
A straight line crossing the y-axis above zero
questions.explain: Direct proportion gives y = kx, a straight line passing through (0, 0).

questions.q: Two quantities are shared in the ratio 3 : 5. What fraction of the total is the first share?
questions.explain: The total is 3 + 5 = 8 parts, so the first share is 3 out of 8.

questions.q: How does compound interest differ from simple interest?
options: Interest is earned on the principal plus previously earned interest
Interest is only ever earned on the original principal
No interest is added until the final year
questions.explain: With compound interest each year's interest is calculated on the growing balance, not just the original amount.

questions.q: Divide £60 in the ratio 2 : 3. What are the two amounts?
questions.explain: There are 5 parts, so one part is £12, giving 2 × £12 = £24 and 3 × £12 = £36.

questions.q: A car travels 150 miles in 3 hours. What is its average speed?
questions.explain: Speed = distance ÷ time = 150 ÷ 3 = 50 mph.
